structured_output.content: The release note only says cert-manager now uses a local fork of the `golang.org/x/crypto/acme` package. It states no behavior change, config key, or API change. The environment shows only a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer, so ACME use is not visible. The key global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole hints at HTTP-01 challenges but doesn't confirm ACME issuers. Missing: PR #7752 details on behavioral differences, and whether any ACME issuers exist.
